name: plenipo
description: Plenipo — local-first desktop AI workforce orchestration platform.

scripts.lint: eslint . --max-warnings 0 && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && node scripts/check-colors.mjs && pnpm docs:links
scripts.bindings: cargo test -p plenipo-core -p plenipo-ledger -p plenipo-runtime -p plenipo-liaison -p plenipo-router -p plenipo-workforce -p plenipo-guard -p plenipo-capabilities -p plenipo-licensing -p plenipo-remote --lib export_bindings
scripts.check: pnpm versions:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
